name: GL_ACCESS_SET_ASSIGNMENTS
description: GL_ACCESS_SET_ASSIGNMENTS contains the access privilege information for each data access set.  Each row includes the data access set, ledger, segment value, and the corresponding access privilege information.  This table stores the flattened information from the GL_ACCESS_SET_NORM_ASSIGN table.  Each ledger set or parent segment value stored in the GL_ACCESS_SET_NORM_ASSIGN table will be expanded into ledger or detail segment values before it is stored in this table.

columns.name: ACCESS_SET_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the access set.

columns.name: SEGMENT_VALUE
columns.description: Balancing or Management segment value used to secure a data access set.

columns.name: ACCESS_PRIVILEGE_CODE
columns.description: Access level of ledger and segment value assignments.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Date from when this access set assignment is active.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Date from when this acesss set assigment is inactive.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
